evidence: Matches 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet transaction creation logic in src/wallet/spend.cpp.
rationale: Prevents integer overflow and an assertion failure crash in CreateTransactionInternal when RPC callers specify recipient amounts exceeding MAX_MONEY. As demonstrated by the author, omitting MoneyRange checks allowed large amounts to wrap around or cause node aborts in RecalculateWaste, though triggering it requires local RPC access with impossible amounts (>21M BTC).
